title: Reverse Logistics: Releasing Items for Redistribution
scope_note: Section 4 (Procedure) steps 4.1-4.10 of SOP-08-C, in DOH Warehouse Operations Manual, 2nd Edition 2022 (data/corpus/DOH_WOM-Manual.pdf, manual pages 163-166 = PDF pages 169-172). This SOP has no contingency section. Step text is the Key Step column verbatim. Verified against the source document by the author on 2026-09-17; see data/graphs/VERIFICATION.md.

steps.text: Upon receiving the notice for reverse logistics from the health program or supply planning unit, check the inventory of the product with the specific batch/lot/serial number and quantity requested for reverse logistics
Coordinate with the health program/supply planning unit
steps.condition: the item with the specific batch/lot/serial number and quantity for reverse logistics is not available and distributed already

steps.text: Generate pick list based on the request from the health program or supply planning unit
steps.condition: the item is in the inventory

steps.text: Pick items from the storage area and segregate to a separate area while waiting for its release
Put a label to the stack for proper identification
Schedule the dispatch of the product with: 1) the upper tier's 3PL (DOH Central or Regional Office) requesting for reverse logistics, or 2) your own 3PL or in-house transport services, if available
Prepare the PTR/BL and Gate Pass (indicating the item is for reverse logistics)
Counter check the documents, quantities and actual item during dispatch process. Ensure that relevant Documents and gate pass are stamped as received by the 3PL/in-house transport service
Consolidate, countercheck and maintain carbon copies of Relevant Documents for filing and review of Supply Officer as necessary
